consular.mission: Canadian Embassy, Dakar; Australian High Commission, Abuja, Nigeria
consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy or consulate in The Gambia. The Canadian Embassy in Dakar, Senegal, gives consular assistance to Australians in The Gambia. This includes issuing Australian provisional travel documents.
